name: Szigetszentmárton (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szigetszentmárton: a white and blue shield with a bend, a fish, a plough and a bunch of grapes, inscribed SZIGETSZENTMÁRTON and SANKT MARTIN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
